description.value: Hide + Seek Coffee is a family-run Victoria café group that started in 2015 with the simple goal of making great coffee in a fun, friendly environment. The Oak Bay Ave flagship is the original location, offering both indoor seating and a patio, and is the home of the brand's popular Waffle Sundays. Cyclists riding through the Oak Bay neighbourhood will find it a welcoming stop with a relaxed neighbourhood feel.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is the Oak Bay Ave location of a three-location, family-run Victoria café operating since 2015. The contact page provides a phone number absent from OSM, and the address '2207 Oak Bay Ave' matches OSM. No bike parking, washroom, water refill, or Wi-Fi amenities are mentioned anywhere on the website; the Fairfield location description ('grab a drink and walk down to the ocean') confirms takeout service across the brand. OSM uses '&' while the website consistently uses '+' in the business name.
concerns: Name mismatch: OSM records 'Hide & Seek Coffee' (ampersand) but the website consistently uses 'Hide + Seek Coffee' (plus sign) — verify which is the legal/preferred name.
Phone number (236) 475-8514 found on website but absent from OSM — OSM record should be updated.

This chain has three locations (Oak Bay Ave, Fairfield Rd, Vic West / Catherine St); the other two locations do not appear to have separate OSM records in this dataset — consider whether they should be listed independently.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active, well-established café on a Victoria cycling corridor with confirmed address and contact details; a useful stop for touring cyclists.
enrichment_extras.notes: The Oak Bay Ave location is described on the website as 'Where it all started' and hosts Waffle Sundays, making it the brand flagship.
